news.title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities May Worsen Critical Electrical Equipment Bottlenecks, Further Delaying the U.S. Ability to Power AI Energy Expansion
news.summary_en: Researchers examined how supply chain vulnerabilities could affect the equipment needed to power frontier artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and, in turn, the U.S. power system’s ability to meet AI demand by 2030.

news.title: Infinite Potential—Insights on Economic and Societal Impacts Across Two Scenarios: After-Action Report from a Series of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Games
news.summary_en: The authors analyze observations from Infinite Potential games that model advanced artificial intelligence causing profound economic disruption, and summarize the issues, capabilities, and recommendations needed to navigate that disruption.
